value.action: began holding court after three ministerial pleas

value.statement: death implied by son's mourning leave

value.reckoning: stated as over one hundred years

label.en: Great General of the Right Thousand-Oxen Guard
Director of the Three Departments Regulations Office

units.zh: 神宗紹天法古運德建功英文烈武欽仁聖孝皇帝，諱頊，英宗長子，母曰宣仁聖烈皇后高氏。
units.en: Emperor Shenzong—full style from Continuing Heaven through Sagely Filial—personal name Xu, was Yingzong’s eldest son; his mother was Empress Xuanren, Lady Gao.
units.literal: Emperor Shenzong, entitled Continuing Heaven, Patterning Antiquity, Transporting Virtue, Establishing Merit, Civil, Martial, Reverent, Benevolent, Sagely, Filial, taboo name Xu, was the eldest son of Yingzong; his mother was Empress Xuanren the Holy and Liege, Lady Gao.

units.zh: 慶曆八年四月戊寅生於濮王宮，祥光照室，群鼠吐五色氣成雲。
units.en: Glorious Calendar 8, fourth month, wuyin: born in the Pu palace amid auspicious light; rats were said to have breathed five-colored clouds.
units.literal: In the eighth year of Glorious Calendar, fourth month, day wuyin, he was born in the Prince of Pu’s palace; auspicious light filled the chamber; a swarm of rats spewed five-colored vapor that formed clouds.

units.zh: 八月，賜名仲鍼。
units.en: Eighth month: he was named Zhongzhen.
units.literal: Eighth month: the name Zhongzhen was bestowed.

units.zh: 授率府副率，三遷至右千牛衛將軍。
units.en: He rose from guard deputy to right thousand-oxen general in three steps.
units.literal: He was made deputy chief of the guard office and thrice promoted to general of the right thousand-oxen guard.

units.zh: 嘉祐八年，侍英宗入居慶甯宮，嘗夢神人捧之登天。
units.en: Jiayou 8: he entered Qingning Palace with Yingzong and dreamed a spirit bore him to Heaven.
units.literal: In the eighth year of Jiayou he attended Yingzong into residence at Qingning Palace and once dreamed a spirit lifted him to ascend Heaven.

units.zh: 英宗即位，授安州觀察使，封光國公。
units.en: At Yingzong’s accession he became An commissioner and Duke of Guangguo.
units.literal: When Yingzong acceded, he was made observation commissioner of An and Duke of Guangguo.

units.zh: 是年五月壬戌，受經於東宮。
units.en: That year, fifth month, renxu: he began classical study in the Eastern Palace.
units.literal: That year, fifth month, day renxu: he received the classics in the Eastern Palace.

units.zh: 帝隆准龍顏，動止皆有常度。
units.en: With a high nose and dragon-like bearing, his every motion was measured.
units.literal: He had a high nose and dragon countenance; movement and rest all had constant measure.

units.zh: 而天性好學，請問至日晏忘食，英宗常遣內侍止之。
units.en: He studied until he forgot meals; Yingzong often sent eunuchs to make him stop.
units.literal: Yet he loved learning by nature, questioning tutors until dusk and forgetting meals; Yingzong often sent eunuchs to stop him.

units.zh: 帝正衣冠拱手，雖大暑，未嘗用扇。
units.en: He kept cap and robes formal and never used a fan even in summer heat.
units.literal: He wore correct cap and robes with joined hands; even in great heat he never used a fan.

units.zh: 侍講王陶入侍，帝率弟顥拜之。
units.en: When Wang Tao lectured, he had his brother Hao bow with him.
units.literal: When lecturer Wang Tao entered to attend, the emperor led his brother Hao in bowing to him.

units.zh: 九月，加忠武軍節度使、同中書門下平章事，封淮陽郡王，改今諱。
units.en: Ninth month: Zhongwu command, co-chancellor, Prince of Huaiyang, and the name Xu.
units.literal: Ninth month: he was added military commissioner of Zhongwu, co-director of the Secretariat-Chancellery, Prince of Huaiyang, and his present taboo name was given.

units.zh: 治平元年六月，進封潁王。
units.en: Zhiping 1, sixth month: he became Prince of Ying.
units.literal: Zhiping year one, sixth month: he was advanced to Prince of Ying.

units.zh: 三年三月，納故相向敏中孫女爲夫人。
units.en: Year three, third month: he married Xiang Minzhong’s granddaughter.
units.literal: Third year, third month: he took the former chief minister Xiang Minzhong’s granddaughter as consort.

units.zh: 十月，英宗不豫，帝引仁宗故事，請兩日一御邇英閣講讀，以安人心。
units.en: Tenth month: with Yingzong ill, he asked to lecture in Yingying Hall every two days, citing Renzong’s precedent.
units.literal: Tenth month: Yingzong was unwell; the emperor cited Renzong’s precedent and asked to lecture in Yingying Hall every two days to steady hearts.

units.zh: 十二月壬寅，立爲皇太子。
units.en: Twelfth month, renyin: he was made crown prince.
units.literal: Twelfth month, day renyin: he was established as crown prince.

units.zh: 四年正月丁巳，英廟崩，帝即皇帝位。
units.en: Year four, first month, dingsi: Yingzong died; he became emperor.
units.literal: Year four, first month, day dingsi: Yingzong died; the emperor took the throne.

units.zh: 戊午，赦天下常赦所不原者。
units.en: On wuwu, amnesty beyond the usual limits.
units.literal: Day wuwu: amnesty even for what the regular amnesty did not spare.

units.zh: 遣馮行己告哀於遼。
units.en: Feng Xingji announced mourning to Liao.
units.literal: Feng Xingji was sent to announce mourning to Liao.

units.zh: 己未，尊皇太后曰太皇太后，皇后曰皇太后。
units.en: On jiwei, the empress became Great Dowager and the consort Dowager.
units.literal: Day jiwei: the empress dowager was honored Great Empress Dowager; the empress was honored Empress Dowager.

units.zh: 命宰相韓琦爲山陵使。
units.en: Han Qi became tomb commissioner.
units.literal: Chief minister Han Qi was made tomb commissioner.

units.zh: 辛酉，遣孫坦等告即位於遼，以大行皇帝詔賜夏國主及西蕃唃廝囉。
units.en: On xinyou, Liao was told of the accession; Xia and Gusiluo received the late emperor’s gifts.
units.literal: Day xinyou: Sun Tan and others announced the accession to Liao; the late emperor’s edict bestowed gifts on the Xia ruler and Gusiluo.

units.zh: 丙寅，群臣表三上，始御迎陽門幄殿聽政。
units.en: On bingyin, after three pleas, he began rule at Yingyang Gate.
units.literal: Day bingyin: after three ministerial memorials, he first held government at the Yingyang Gate canopy hall.

units.zh: 內醫侍先帝疾者，皆坐不謹貶之。
units.en: Physicians who had tended the late emperor were punished for negligence.
units.literal: Inner physicians who had attended the late emperor were all punished for negligence.

units.zh: 詔東平郡王允弼、襄陽郡王允良朝朔望。
units.en: Princes Yunbi and Yunliang were ordered to attend at each new and full moon.
units.literal: Edict: Prince of Dongping Yunbi and Prince of Xiangyang Yunliang were to attend on new and full moons.

units.zh: 以吳奎終喪，復授樞密副使。
units.en: Wu Kui, mourning done, returned as vice military affairs commissioner.
units.literal: Wu Kui, mourning ended, was again made vice military affairs commissioner.

units.zh: 戊辰，以韓琦守司空兼侍中，曾公亮行門下侍郎兼吏部尚書、進封英國公，文彥博行尚書左僕射、檢校司徒兼中書令，富弼改武甯軍節度使、進封鄭國公，曹佾改昭慶軍節度使、檢校太傅，張昪改河陽三城節度使，宗諤同中書門下平章事，改集慶軍節度使、檢校尚書左僕射，歐陽修、趙槩並加尚書左丞，仍參知政事，陳升之爲戶部侍郎，呂公弼爲刑部侍郎，允弼、允良並加守太保，弟東陽郡王顥進封昌王，鄠國公頵進封樂安郡王。
units.en: On wuchen the cabinet was reshaped: Han Qi, Zeng Gongliang, Wen Yanbo, Fu Bi, Cao Yi, Zhang Sheng, Zongnu, Ouyang Xiu, Zhao Gai, Chen Shengzhi, Lü Gongbi, and the princes received new ranks and posts.
units.literal: Day wuchen: Han Qi kept minister of works with palace attendant; Zeng Gongliang acting vice director of the Chancellery with personnel minister, advanced Duke of Ying; Wen Yanbo acting left vice director with inspection grand mentor and concurrent director of the Secretariat; Fu Bi changed to Wuning command and Duke of Zheng; Cao Yi changed to Zhaoqing command and grand mentor; Zhang Sheng changed to Heyang command; Zongnu co-director of the Secretariat-Chancellery, Jiqing command, inspection left vice director; Ouyang Xiu and Zhao Gai both added left vice director and participating administrator; Chen Shengzhi personnel vice minister; Lü Gongbi punishment vice minister; Yunbi and Yunliang both added acting grand guardian; brother Prince of Dongyang Hao advanced Prince of Chang; Prince of E Yun advanced Prince of Le’an.

units.zh: 群臣進秩有差。
units.en: Officials were promoted by degree.
units.literal: Officials were advanced in rank by degree.

units.zh: 二月乙酉，初御紫宸殿。
units.en: Second month, yiyou: he first held court in Zichen Hall.
units.literal: Second month, day yiyou: for the first time he held court at Zichen Hall.

units.zh: 立向氏爲皇后。
units.en: Lady Xiang became empress.
units.literal: Lady Xiang was established as empress.

units.zh: 丁亥，詔入內內侍省、皇城司合覆奏事並執條覆奏。
units.en: On dinghai, inner palace and city offices were ordered to memorial jointly and review item by item.
units.literal: Day dinghai, edict: the inner palace service bureau and imperial city office—joint memorials and line-by-line review.

units.zh: 戊子，進封交阯郡王李日尊爲南平王。
units.en: On wuzi, Li Rizun became Prince of Nanping.
units.literal: Day wuzi: Jiaozhi Prince Li Rizun was advanced to Prince of Nanping.

units.zh: 加邈川首領董氈檢校太保。
units.en: Dong Zhan of Miaochuan received inspection grand guardian rank.
units.literal: Miaochuan chief Dong Zhan was added inspection grand guardian.

units.zh: 詔山陵所須，應委三司、轉運司計置，毋輒擾民。
units.en: Tomb supplies were to come from the three departments without troubling the people.
units.literal: Edict: tomb needs were to be planned by the three departments and transport offices without disturbing the people.

units.zh: 詔提舉醫官院試堪診御脈者六人。
units.en: Six pulse physicians were to be tested at the medical academy.
units.literal: Edict: the medical academy was to test six men fit to feel the imperial pulse.

units.zh: 庚寅，以四月十日爲同天節。
units.en: On gengyin, the tenth of the fourth month became Shared Heaven festival.
units.literal: Day gengyin: the tenth day of the fourth month was made the Shared Heaven festival.

units.zh: 辛卯，白虹貫日。
units.en: On xinmao, a white rainbow crossed the sun.
units.literal: Day xinmao: a white rainbow pierced the sun.

units.zh: 壬辰，詔公主下嫁者行見舅姑禮。
units.en: On renchen, marrying princesses were to meet their in-laws formally.
units.literal: Day renchen, edict: princesses marrying were to perform the meeting-the-in-laws rite.

units.zh: 甲辰，西蕃首領拽羅缽、鳩令結二人誘蕃部三百余帳投夏國，捕獲，斬之以徇。
units.en: On jiachen, Fan chiefs who led three hundred tents to Xia were captured and executed.
units.literal: Day jiachen: western Fan chiefs Zhuailuobo and Jiulingjie enticed more than three hundred tents to defect to Xia; captured, they were beheaded as warning.

units.zh: 三月壬子，曹佾加檢校太尉兼侍中。
units.en: Third month, renzi: Cao Yi received acting grand marshal and palace attendant.
units.literal: Third month, day renzi: Cao Yi was made acting grand marshal and palace attendant.

units.zh: 賜禮部進士及第、出身四百六十一人。
units.en: Four hundred sixty-one Ministry of Rites jinshi and degree holders were awarded.
units.literal: Four hundred sixty-one Ministry of Rites jinshi graduates and successful candidates were granted.

units.zh: 甲寅，陝西宣撫使郭逵討蕃部黨令征等，平之。
units.en: On jiayin, Guo Kui of Shaanxi pacification suppressed Fan leaders including Danglingzheng.
units.literal: Day jiayin: Shaanxi pacification commissioner Guo Kui attacked Fan chieftains Danglingzheng and others and pacified them.

units.zh: 賜昌王顥公使錢歲萬緡，半給之。
units.en: Prince of Chang Hao received ten thousand strings yearly in envoy funds; half was paid.
units.literal: Prince of Chang Hao was granted official envoy funds of ten thousand strings yearly; half was given.

units.zh: 丙辰，昌王顥、樂安郡王頵乞解官行服，不許。
units.en: On bingchen, Hao and Yun asked to resign for mourning; the request was denied.
units.literal: Day bingchen: Prince of Chang Hao and Prince of Le'an Yun begged to leave office for mourning; not permitted.

units.zh: 癸亥，詔入內內侍省官已經壽聖節任子者，同天節權罷奏薦。
units.en: On guihai, attendant officials who had already gained hereditary posts at Longevity-Sage festival were temporarily barred from Shared Heaven recommendations.
units.literal: Day guihai, edict: Inner Palace attendant officials who had already received hereditary posts at the Longevity-Sage festival were temporarily barred from memorial recommendations at the Shared Heaven festival.

units.zh: 壬申，歐陽修罷知亳州。
units.en: On renshen, Ouyang Xiu left the Bozhou prefecture.
units.literal: Day renshen: Ouyang Xiu was dismissed as Bozhou prefect.

units.zh: 癸酉，吳奎參知政事。
units.en: On guiyou, Wu Kui became participating administrator.
units.literal: Day guiyou: Wu Kui was made participating administrator.

units.zh: 乙亥，允良薨。
units.en: On yihai, Yunliang died.
units.literal: Day yihai: Yunliang died.

units.zh: 閏月癸未，太白晝見。
units.en: Intercalary month, guiwei: Venus shone in daylight.
units.literal: Intercalary month, day guiwei: Venus appeared by day.

units.zh: 甲申，夏國主諒祚遣使謝罪。
units.en: On jiashen, Liangzuo sent apology envoys.
units.literal: Day jiashen: Xia ruler Liangzuo sent envoys to apologize.

units.zh: 辛卯，詔齊、密、登、華、邠、耀、鄜、絳、潤、婺、海、宿、饒、歙、吉、建、汀、潮等十八州知州，慶、渭、秦、延四州通判，其選並從中書，毋以恩例奏授。
units.en: On xinmao, eighteen prefects and four frontier magistrates were to be Secretariat picks, not favors.
units.literal: Day xinmao, edict: prefects of eighteen prefectures and four frontier magistrates—their selection was from the Secretariat, not favor nominations.

units.zh: 乙未，張昪以太子太師致仕。
units.en: On yiwei, Zhang Sheng retired as heir’s grand mentor.
units.literal: Day yiwei: Zhang Sheng retired as grand mentor of the heir.

units.zh: 庚子，詔求直言。
units.en: On gengzi, the throne called for blunt memorials.
units.literal: Day gengzi, edict: frank counsel was sought.

units.zh: 御史中丞王陶乞許舉知縣資序人爲御史裏行，從之。
units.en: Wang Tao won permission to nominate county-qualified censor trainees.
units.literal: Censor-in-chief Wang Tao asked to nominate men of county-magistrate qualification as censor trainees; assent.

units.zh: 癸卯，王安石出知江寧府。
units.en: On guimao, Wang Anshi became Jiangning prefect.
units.literal: Day guimao: Wang Anshi went out as prefect of Jiangning.

units.zh: 甲辰，詔諸路帥臣及副總管或有移易，依慶曆故事。
units.en: On jiachen, frontier command transfers followed Glorious Calendar rules.
units.literal: Day jiachen, edict: when frontier commanders or deputy commissioners moved, Glorious Calendar precedent applied.

units.zh: 乙巳，詔以孟夏農勞之時，令監司戒飭州縣省事，勸民力田，民有艱食者振之。
units.en: On yisi, early-summer orders urged lighter government and famine relief.
units.literal: Day yisi, edict: in early summer labor, inspectors were to warn prefectures to lighten affairs and urge farming; famine victims were to be relieved.

units.zh: 夏四月庚戌，請大行皇帝諡于南郊。
units.en: Fourth month, gengxu: ministers sought the late emperor’s posthumous title.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengxu: the late emperor’s posthumous title was requested at the southern suburb.

units.zh: 辛酉，詔內外所上封事，令張方平、司馬光詳定以聞。
units.en: On xinyou, Zhang Fangping and Sima Guang were to review sealed memorials.
units.literal: Day xinyou, edict: sealed memorials within and without were to be reviewed by Zhang Fangping and Sima Guang.

units.zh: 丙寅，錄囚。
units.en: On bingyin, the prisons were reviewed.
units.literal: Day bingyin: prisoners were reviewed.

units.zh: 御史中丞王陶、侍御史吳申、呂景以過毀大臣，陶出知陳州，申、景各罰銅二十斤。
units.en: Wang Tao, Wu Shen, and Lü Jing, who had savaged ministers, were punished—Tao to Chen, the others twenty jin of copper each.
units.literal: Censor-in-chief Wang Tao and investigating censors Wu Shen and Lü Jing were punished for excessive attacks on ministers: Tao went out as Chen prefect; Shen and Jing each fined twenty jin of copper.

units.zh: 吳奎罷知青州。
units.en: Wu Kui lost the Qing prefecture.
units.literal: Wu Kui was dismissed as acting Qing prefect.

units.zh: 遣使循行陝西、河北、京東、京西路，體量安撫。
units.en: Inspectors were dispatched through Shaanxi, Hebei, and the eastern circuits to measure distress and comfort the people.
units.literal: Envoys were sent to tour Shaanxi, Hebei, Jingdong, and Jingxi circuits to inspect conditions and give relief.

units.zh: 壬申，奎復位。
units.en: On renshen, Wu Kui returned to his post.
units.literal: Day renshen: Kui was restored to office.

units.zh: 罷州郡歲貢飲食果藥。
units.en: Prefectures ceased sending yearly food, fruit, and drug tribute.
units.literal: Annual tribute of food, fruit, and medicine from prefectures was abolished.

units.zh: 癸酉，詔陝西、河東經略、轉運司察主兵臣僚怯懦老病者以聞。
units.en: On guiyou, the Shaanxi and Hedong frontier and transport offices were ordered to report military officials who were cowardly, aged, or ill.
units.literal: Day guiyou, edict: Shaanxi and Hedong frontier commissioners and transport offices were to report military officials who were timid, aged, or ill.

units.zh: 五月辛巳，以久旱，命宰臣禱雨。
units.en: Fifth month, xinsi: the drought drove the cabinet to pray for rain.
units.literal: Fifth month, day xinsi: because of long drought, chief ministers were ordered to pray for rain.

units.zh: 乙巳，寶文閣成，置學士、直學士、待制官。
units.en: On yisi, Baowen Pavilion opened with its full roster of scholars.
units.literal: Day yisi: the Baowen Pavilion was completed; academicians, direct academicians, and drafting officials were appointed.

units.zh: 六月己酉，遼遣蕭余慶等來弔祭。
units.en: Sixth month, jiyou: Liao envoys came to mourn the late emperor.
units.literal: Sixth month, day jiyou: Liao sent Xiao Yuqing and others to offer mourning rites.

units.zh: 己未，振河北流民。
units.en: On jiwei, Hebei wanderers received relief grain.
units.literal: Day jiwei: Hebei refugees were relieved.

units.zh: 辛未，詔天下官吏有能知徭役利病可議寬減者以聞。
units.en: On xinwei, the throne asked officials who understood corvée burdens to propose relief.
units.literal: Day xinwei, edict: officials who knew corvée abuses and could propose reductions were to report.

units.zh: 乙亥，詔中書、樞密細務歸之有司。
units.en: On yihai, petty Secretariat and Military Affairs matters went back to line agencies.
units.literal: Day yihai, edict: minor Secretariat and Military Affairs business was returned to the proper offices.

units.zh: 秋七月庚辰，詔察富民與妃嬪家婚姻夤緣得官者。
units.en: Seventh month, gengchen: the court hunted officials bought with consort-clan marriages.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day gengchen, edict: investigate rich men who gained office through marriage ties with imperial consorts' kin.

units.zh: 甲申，石蕃來貢。
units.en: On jiashen, Shifan presented tribute.
units.literal: Day jiashen: Shifan came to offer tribute.

units.zh: 己丑，命尚書戶部郎中趙抃、刑部郎中陳薦同詳定中外封事。
units.en: On jichou, Zhao Bian and Chen Jian were assigned to sift sealed memorials.
units.literal: Day jichou: Households Minister Zhao Bian and Punishments Minister Chen Jian were ordered jointly to review memorials from within and without.

units.zh: 辛卯，告英宗憲文肅武宣孝皇帝諡于天地、宗廟、社稷。
units.en: On xinmao, Yingzong's full posthumous style was proclaimed to Heaven, Earth, temple, and altars.
units.literal: Day xinmao: Yingzong's posthumous title Reverent, Civil, Solemn, Martial, Proclaiming Filial was announced to Heaven, Earth, the ancestral temple, and the altars of soil and grain.

units.zh: 壬辰，上寶冊于福寧殿。
units.en: On renchen, the jade book of reign was laid before Funing Hall.
units.literal: Day renchen: the precious register was presented at Funing Hall.

units.zh: 丙午，文州曲水縣令宇文之邵上書指陳得失。
units.en: On bingwu, a county magistrate named Yuwen Zhishao sent blunt counsel.
units.literal: Day bingwu: Wenzhou Qushui magistrate Yuwen Zhishao memorialized on gains and losses.

units.zh: 八月丁未朔，太白晝見。
units.en: Eighth month, dingwei new moon: Venus shone at noon.
units.literal: Eighth month, day dingwei, first of month: Venus appeared by day.

units.zh: 戊午，復西夏和市。
units.en: On wuwu, trade with Western Xia resumed.
units.literal: Day wuwu: the Xia border market was reopened.

units.zh: 己巳，京師地震。
units.en: On jisi, the capital shook.
units.literal: Day jisi: the capital earthquake.

units.zh: 癸酉，葬英宗於永厚陵。
units.en: On guiyou, Yingzong entered Yonghou tomb.
units.literal: Day guiyou: Yingzong was buried at Yonghou tomb.

units.zh: 九月丁丑，詔減諸路逃田稅額。
units.en: Ninth month, dingchou: abandoned-field tax quotas were cut across the circuits.
units.literal: Ninth month, day dingchou, edict: tax quotas on abandoned fields in all circuits were reduced.

units.zh: 壬午，祧僖祖及文懿皇后。
units.en: On renwu, Xizu and Empress Wenyi were moved to distant-line status.
units.literal: Day renwu: Emperor Xizu and Empress Wenyi were moved to distant-line status.

units.zh: 乙酉，祔英宗神主于太廟，樂曰《大英之舞》。
units.en: On yiyou, Yingzong's tablet entered the Grand Temple to the dance "Great Splendor."
units.literal: Day yiyou: Yingzong's spirit tablet was enshrined in the Grand Ancestral Temple; the dance was called "Great Splendor Dance."

units.zh: 戊子，減兩京、畿內、鄭、孟州囚罪一等，民役山陵者蠲其賦。
units.en: On wuzi, capital-region prisoners gained one-grade leniency; tomb laborers were exempted from taxes.
units.literal: Day wuzi: prisoners in the two capitals, metropolitan region, Zheng, and Meng prefectures had sentences reduced one grade; commoners serving on the imperial tomb were exempted from levies.

units.zh: 辛卯，徙封顥爲岐王，頵爲高密郡王。
units.en: On xinmao, Hao became Prince of Qi and Yun Prince of Gaomi.
units.literal: Day xinmao: Hao was transferred and enfeoffed as Prince of Qi; Yun as Prince of Gaomi.

units.zh: 富弼爲尚書左僕射。
units.en: Fu Bi became left vice director of the Secretariat.
units.literal: Fu Bi was made left vice director of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 遣孫思恭等報謝於遼，且賀生辰、正旦。
units.en: Sun Sigong was dispatched to Liao to give thanks and greet the new year and imperial birthday.
units.literal: Sun Sigong and others were sent to Liao to return thanks and also congratulate on birthday and New Year's Day.

units.zh: 壬辰，錄周世宗從曾孫貽廓爲三班奉職。
units.en: On renchen, Shizong's collateral descendant Yikuo was made third-rank attendant.
units.literal: Day renchen: Later Zhou Shizong's collateral great-great-grandson Yikuo was enrolled as third-rank attendant.

units.zh: 甲午，遼遣耶律好謀等來賀即位。
units.en: On jiawu, Liao envoys including Yelü Haomou came to congratulate the accession.
units.literal: Day jiawu: Liao sent Yelü Haomou and others to congratulate on the enthronement.

units.zh: 戊戌，以王安石爲翰林學士。
units.en: On wuxu, Wang Anshi entered the Hanlin Academy.
units.literal: Day wuxu: Wang Anshi was made Hanlin academician.

units.zh: 辛丑，韓琦罷爲司徒、鎮安武勝軍節度使、判相州。
units.en: On xinchou, Han Qi left office as minister of education and Xiangzhou commissioner.
units.literal: Day xinchou: Han Qi was dismissed as minister of education, military commissioner of Zhen'an Wusheng Army, and Xiangzhou administrator.

units.zh: 吳奎、陳升之罷。
units.en: Wu Kui and Chen Shengzhi were removed.
units.literal: Wu Kui and Chen Shengzhi were dismissed.

units.zh: 樞密副使呂公弼爲樞密使，張方平、趙抃並參知政事，邵亢爲樞密副使。
units.en: Lü Gongbi became military affairs commissioner; Zhang Fangping and Zhao Bian joined the Secretariat; Shao Kang became vice commissioner.
units.literal: Vice commissioner of military affairs Lü Gongbi was made commissioner; Zhang Fangping and Zhao Bian were both participating administrators; Shao Kang was made vice commissioner.

units.zh: 壬寅，以曾公亮爲尚書左僕射，文彥博爲司空。
units.en: On renyin, Zeng Gongliang became left vice director and Wen Yanbo minister of works.
units.literal: Day renyin: Zeng Gongliang was made left vice director; Wen Yanbo was made minister of works.

units.zh: 潮州地震。
units.en: Chaozhou shook.
units.literal: Chaozhou earthquake.

units.zh: 癸卯，以權御史中丞司馬光爲翰林學士。
units.en: On guimao, acting censorate director Sima Guang joined the Hanlin Academy.
units.literal: Day guimao: acting censorate director Sima Guang was made Hanlin academician.

units.zh: 冬十月丙午，漳、泉諸州地震。
units.en: Tenth month, bingwu: Zhang and Quan shook.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingwu: Zhang and Quan prefectures earthquake.

units.zh: 丁未，富弼罷判河陽。
units.en: On dingwei, Fu Bi left Heyang.
units.literal: Day dingwei: Fu Bi was dismissed as Heyang administrator.

units.zh: 戊申，建州、邵武、興化軍地震。
units.en: On wushen, earthquakes struck Jian Prefecture and the Shaowu and Xinghua armies.
units.literal: Day wushen: Jian Prefecture, Shaowu Army, and Xinghua Army had earthquakes.

units.zh: 己酉，初御邇英閣，召侍臣講讀經史。
units.en: On jiyou, he first lectured in Yingying Hall on the classics.
units.literal: Day jiyou: for the first time he held lecture in Yingying Hall, summoning attendants to read classics and history.

units.zh: 以右諫議大夫、權御史中丞滕甫考諸路監司課績。
units.en: Teng Fu was charged to grade the circuit inspectors.
units.literal: Right remonstrance officer and acting censor-in-chief Teng Fu was to assess circuit inspectors' performance.

units.zh: 張方平以父憂去位。
units.en: Zhang Fangping withdrew for mourning.
units.literal: Zhang Fangping left office on his father's mourning.

units.zh: 庚戌，給陝西轉運司度僧牒。
units.en: On gengxu, Shaanxi received monk-sale quotas for famine funds.
units.literal: Day gengxu: monk certificates were issued to the Shaanxi transport office.

units.zh: 令糴穀振霜旱州縣。
units.en: The court bought grain for frost- and drought-hit counties.
units.literal: Grain was bought to relieve frost- and drought-stricken prefectures.

units.zh: 癸丑，詔翰林學士、御史中丞、侍御史知雜事舉材堪御史者各二人。
units.en: On guichou, senior scholars and censors were each to name two censor candidates.
units.literal: Day guichou, edict: Hanlin academicians, the censor-in-chief, and the chief investigating censor each nominated two men fit for censor.

units.zh: 詔將作監主簿常秩赴闕。
units.en: Chang Zhi was summoned from the works registrar's post.
units.literal: Edict: Palace Directorate registrar Chang Zhi was to come to court.

units.zh: 甲寅，制《資治通鑒序》賜司馬光。
units.en: On jiayin, he wrote the Mirror's preface for Sima Guang.
units.literal: Day jiayin: he composed the preface to Comprehensive Mirror and bestowed it on Sima Guang.

units.zh: 癸酉，知青澗城種諤復綏州。
units.en: On guiyou, Zhong E took back Suizhou.
units.literal: Day guiyou: Qingjian commander Zhong E recovered Suizhou.

units.zh: 十一月丁丑，詔近臣各舉才行可任使者一人。
units.en: Eleventh month, dingchou: every court intimate was to name one envoy-worthy man.
units.literal: Eleventh month, day dingchou, edict: each close minister was to recommend one man of talent fit for envoy duty.

units.zh: 戊寅，詔求直言。
units.en: On wuyin, the throne again called for blunt speech.
units.literal: Day wuyin, edict: frank counsel was sought.

units.zh: 丙戌，詔二府各舉所知。
units.en: On bingxu, both Secretariat and Military Affairs filed talent lists.
units.literal: Day bingxu, edict: the two bureaus each recommended men they knew.

units.zh: 丁亥，令考課院詳定諸州所上縣令治狀。
units.en: On dinghai, magistrates' performance dossiers went to the review office.
units.literal: Day dinghai: the Performance Review Office was to judge county magistrates' reports of governance.

units.zh: 戊子，分命宰臣祈雪。
units.en: On wuzi, each minister prayed for snow in turn.
units.literal: Day wuzi: chief ministers were separately ordered to pray for snow.

units.zh: 置馬監於河東交城縣。
units.en: Hedong's Jiaocheng received a state horse farm.
units.literal: A horse stud was established at Jiaocheng in Hedong.

units.zh: 庚寅，詔近臣以舉官不當，經三劾者，中書別奏取旨。
units.en: On gengyin, three failed nominations cost a courtier his referral privilege.
units.literal: Day gengyin, edict: when a close minister's nomination proved wrong three times, the Secretariat was to memorialize separately for imperial decision.

units.zh: 乙未，詔令內外文武官各舉有材德行能者。
units.en: On yiwei, every official was told to name able men of good character.
units.literal: Day yiwei, edict: civil and military officials within and without were each to recommend men of talent, conduct, and ability.

units.zh: 十二月丙辰，西南龍蕃來貢。
units.en: Twelfth month, bingchen: Long Fan of the southwest paid tribute.
units.literal: Twelfth month, day bingchen: southwestern Long Fan came to offer tribute.

units.zh: 辛酉，以來歲日食正旦，自乙丑避殿、減膳、罷朝賀。
units.en: On xinyou, next year's New Year eclipse brought austerity from yichou—no hall, lean table, no felicitations.
units.literal: Day xinyou: because an eclipse would fall on New Year's Day next year, from day yichou the throne avoided the main hall, reduced meals, and canceled court congratulations.

units.zh: 壬戌，詔起居日增轉對官二人。
units.en: On renxu, two more speakers were added to daily audiences.
units.literal: Day renxu, edict: on routine-audience days two more rotating memorialists were added.

units.zh: 丙寅，詔州縣吏並緣爲奸，致獄多瘐死，歲終會死者多寡，以制其罪。
units.en: On bingyin, jail deaths caused by clerk fraud would be counted yearly and punished.
units.literal: Day bingyin, edict: when clerks and runners committed fraud and prisoners died in custody, year-end tallies of deaths would fix their punishment.

units.zh: 著爲令。
units.en: The rule was written into law.
units.literal: This was enacted as statute.

units.zh: 己巳，遼遣蕭傑等來賀正旦。
units.en: On jisi, Liao envoys came for New Year.
units.literal: Day jisi: Liao sent Xiao Jie and others to congratulate the new year.

units.zh: 熙甯元年春正月甲戌朔，日有食之。
units.en: Xining 1, first month, jiaxu new moon: the sun was eaten.
units.literal: Xining year one, spring, first month, day jiaxu, new moon: there was an eclipse of the sun.

units.zh: 詔改元。
units.en: The era name was proclaimed Xining.
units.literal: Edict: the reign era was changed.

units.zh: 丁丑，以旱，減天下囚罪一等，杖以下釋之。
units.en: On dingchou, drought amnesty cut sentences one grade and freed the lightly punished.
units.literal: Day dingchou: because of drought, crimes were reduced one degree empire-wide; those below the cudgel were released.

units.zh: 壬午，令州縣掩暴骸。
units.en: On renwu, counties were told to bury the unburied dead.
units.literal: Day renwu: prefectures were ordered to bury exposed corpses.

units.zh: 丁亥，命宰臣曾公亮等極言闕失。
units.en: On dinghai, Zeng Gongliang's cabinet was commanded to name every fault.
units.literal: Day dinghai: chief ministers Zeng Gongliang and others were ordered to speak freely on omissions.

units.zh: 庚寅，御殿復膳。
units.en: On gengyin, the emperor returned to the hall and full rations.
units.literal: Day gengyin: the throne resumed full meals in the hall.

units.zh: 壬辰，幸寺觀祈雨。
units.en: On renchen, he prayed for rain at the temples.
units.literal: Day renchen: he visited temples to pray for rain.

units.zh: 丙申，趙概罷知徐州，三司使唐介參知政事。
units.en: On bingshen, Zhao Gai left Xuzhou and Tang Jie joined the council.
units.literal: Day bingshen: Zhao Gai was dismissed as Xuzhou prefect; Three Departments commissioner Tang Jie became participating administrator.

units.zh: 丁酉，詔修《英宗實錄》。
units.en: On dingyou, work on Yingzong's Veritable Records began.
units.literal: Day dingyou, edict: compile Veritable Records of Yingzong.

units.zh: 壬寅，增太學生百人。
units.en: On renyin, the university gained a hundred seats.
units.literal: Day renyin: the Imperial University was increased by one hundred students.

units.zh: 二月辛亥，令諸路每季上雨雪。
units.en: Second month, xinhai: every circuit filed seasonal rainfall.
units.literal: Second month, day xinhai: each circuit was to report quarterly rain and snow.

units.zh: 乙卯，孔若蒙襲封衍聖公。
units.en: On yimao, Kong Ruomeng became Duke of Fulfilled Sageliness.
units.literal: Day yimao: Kong Ruomeng inherited the title Duke of Fulfilled Sageliness.

units.zh: 壬戌，貸河東饑民粟。
units.en: On renxu, Hedong famine victims received grain loans.
units.literal: Day renxu: grain was lent to famine victims in Hedong.

units.zh: 三月庚辰，夏主諒詐卒，遣使來告哀。
units.en: Third month, gengchen: Liangzuo of Xia died; his court sent mourners.
units.literal: Third month, day gengchen: Xia ruler Liangzha died; envoys came to announce mourning.

units.zh: 丙戌，詔恤刑。
units.en: On bingxu, the throne ordered gentler justice.
units.literal: Day bingxu, edict: show mercy in punishments.

units.zh: 戊子，作太皇太后慶壽宮、皇太后寶慈宮。
units.en: On wuzi, new palaces rose for both empresses dowager.
units.literal: Day wuzi: palaces of Longevity for the Great Empress Dowager and of Precious Kindness for the Empress Dowager were built.

units.zh: 丁酉，簡州木連理，潭州雨毛。
units.en: On dingyou, Jian saw conjoined trees and Tan, feather rain.
units.literal: Day dingyou: Jian prefecture reported joined tree trunks; Tan prefecture, rain of feathers.

units.zh: 夏四月乙巳，詔翰林學士王安石越次入對。
units.en: Fourth month, yisi: Wang Anshi was summoned ahead of his rank.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yisi, edict: Hanlin academician Wang Anshi was to enter audience out of turn.

units.zh: 戊申，命宰臣禱雨。
units.en: On wushen, the cabinet prayed for rain again.
units.literal: Day wushen: chief ministers were ordered to pray for rain.

units.zh: 以樞密直學士李參爲尚書右丞、判西京留守司御史台。
units.en: Li Can became right vice director at the Western Capital.
units.literal: Military Affairs direct academician Li Can was made right vice director and administrator of the Western Capital remonstrance bureau.

units.zh: 辛亥，同天節，群臣及遼使初上壽於紫宸殿。
units.en: On xinhai, Shared Heaven: court and Liao envoys first wished long life in Zichen Hall.
units.literal: Day xinhai: Shared Heaven festival; ministers and Liao envoys first offered longevity felicitations at Zichen Hall.

units.zh: 五月甲戌，募饑民補廂軍。
units.en: Fifth month, jiaxu: starving men were enlisted into the guard.
units.literal: Fifth month, day jiaxu: famine victims were recruited into the courier guard.

units.zh: 庚辰，詔兩制及國子監舉諸王宮學官。
units.en: On gengchen, drafters and the university were to name princes' tutors.
units.literal: Day gengchen, edict: drafting officials and the Directorate of Education were to nominate tutors for the princes' school.

units.zh: 戊戌，廢慶成軍。
units.en: On wuxu, Qingcheng garrison was disbanded.
units.literal: Day wuxu: Qingcheng army was abolished.

units.zh: 六月癸卯，錄唐魏征、狄仁傑後。
units.en: Sixth month, guimao: heirs of Wei Zheng and Di Renjie were ennobled.
units.literal: Sixth month, day guimao: descendants of Tang's Wei Zheng and Di Renjie were recorded and honored.

units.zh: 丁未，占城來貢。
units.en: On dingwei, Champa sent tribute.
units.literal: Day dingwei: Champa came to offer tribute.

units.zh: 辛亥，詔諸路興水利。
units.en: On xinhai, every circuit was ordered to dig canals and dikes.
units.literal: Day xinhai, edict: each circuit was to promote waterworks.

units.zh: 乙亥，河決棗強縣。
units.en: On yihai, the Yellow River broke through at Zaoqiang.
units.literal: Day yihai: the Yellow River burst at Zaoqiang county.

units.zh: 丙寅，命司馬光、滕甫裁定國用。
units.en: On bingyin, Sima Guang and Teng Fu were told to balance the treasury.
units.literal: Day bingyin: Sima Guang and Teng Fu were ordered to fix state expenditure.

units.zh: 秋七月癸酉，詔謀殺已傷，案問欲舉自首者，從謀殺減二等。
units.en: Seventh month, guiyou: would-be murderers who surrendered after wounding received two degrees off the capital charge.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guiyou, edict: in cases of intended murder where the victim was already wounded and the assailant wished to confess before trial, reduce two degrees from murder.

units.zh: 乙亥，名秦州新築大甘穀口砦曰甘穀城。
units.en: On yihai, Qin's new Sweet Valley fort was proclaimed a city.
units.literal: Day yihai: the new Qin prefecture fort at Great Sweet Valley Pass was named Sweet Valley city.

units.zh: 丁丑，詔諸路帥臣、監司及兩制、知雜御史已上，各舉武勇謀略三班使臣二名。
units.en: On dingchou, every senior official named two bold military agents.
units.literal: Day dingchou, edict: circuit commanders, inspectors, drafting officials, and chief investigating censors and above each nominated two third-rank military envoys of martial courage and stratagem.

units.zh: 賜布衣王安國進士及第。
units.en: Wang Anguo, a commoner, passed the jinshi.
units.literal: Commoner Wang Anguo was granted jinshi standing.

units.zh: 己卯，群臣三表請上奉元憲道文武仁孝之號，不許。
units.en: On jimao, three pleas for a grand honorific title were refused.
units.literal: Day jimao: ministers thrice memorialized the style Upholding Origin, Sagely Way, Civil, Martial, Benevolent, Filial; refused.

units.zh: 陳升之知樞密院事。
units.en: Chen Shengzhi took Military Affairs.
units.literal: Chen Shengzhi became Military Affairs commissioner.

units.zh: 給濮州雷澤縣堯陵守戶。
units.en: Pu's Leize received guard households for Emperor Yao's mound.
units.literal: Households were assigned to guard Yao tomb in Leize, Pu prefecture.

units.zh: 壬午，以恩、冀州河決，賜水死家緡錢及下戶粟。
units.en: On renwu, Hebei flood victims received cash and grain.
units.literal: Day renwu: because the En and Ji prefecture river had burst, cash was given families of the drowned and grain to poor households.

units.zh: 甲申，京師地震。
units.en: On jiashen, the capital shook again.
units.literal: Day jiashen: the capital earthquake.

units.zh: 乙酉，又震，大雨。
units.en: On yiyou, a second quake and torrential rain.
units.literal: Day yiyou: again it shook; great rain.

units.zh: 辛卯，以河朔地大震，命沿邊安撫司及雄州刺史候遼人動息以聞。
units.en: On xinmao, the Hebei quake put border offices on alert for Liao.
units.literal: Day xinmao: because of the great Hebei earthquake, frontier pacification offices and Xiong prefecture were to watch Khitan movements and report.

units.zh: 賜壓死者緡錢。
units.en: Families of the buried received relief money.
units.literal: Cash was given to those crushed to death.

units.zh: 京師地再震。
units.en: The capital trembled twice again.
units.literal: The capital earth shook twice more.

units.zh: 壬辰，遣御史中丞滕甫、知制誥吳充安撫河北。
units.en: On renchen, Teng Fu and Wu Chong went to comfort Hebei.
units.literal: Day renchen: censor-in-chief Teng Fu and drafting academician Wu Chong were sent to pacify Hebei.

units.zh: 癸巳，疏深州溢水。
units.en: On guisi, Shenzhou's flood was channeled off.
units.literal: Day guisi: overflow from Shen prefecture was drained.

units.zh: 甲午，減河北路囚罪一等。
units.en: On jiawu, Hebei sentences were cut one grade.
units.literal: Day jiawu: Hebei circuit prisoners' crimes were reduced one degree.

units.zh: 丁酉，賜河北安撫司空名誥敕，募民入粟。
units.en: On dingyou, Hebei was told to buy grain with blank patents.
units.literal: Day dingyou: Hebei pacification commissioner was given blank commission patents; the people were urged to sell grain.

units.zh: 己亥，回鶻來貢。
units.en: On jihai, Uighur envoys arrived.
units.literal: Day jihai: the Uighurs came to offer tribute.

units.zh: 八月壬寅，詔京東、西路存恤河北流民。
units.en: Eighth month, renyin: eastern circuits sheltered Hebei refugees.
units.literal: Eighth month, day renyin, edict: Jingdong and Jingxi were to care for Hebei refugees.

units.zh: 京師地震。
units.en: The capital shook once more.
units.literal: The capital earthquake.

units.zh: 甲辰，又震。
units.en: On jiachen, another tremor.
units.literal: Day jiachen: again it shook.

units.zh: 乙卯，賜河東及鄜延路轉運司空名誥敕，募民入粟實邊。
units.en: On yimao, the transport offices of Hedong and Fuyan Route were given blank patents and edicts to recruit civilians to deliver grain and fill the frontier granaries.
units.literal: Day yimao: Hedong and Fuyan route transport commissioners were given blank patents; the people were urged to sell grain to fill the frontier stores.

units.zh: 甲子，詔中書門下，考屬近行尊者一人，王之。
units.en: On jiazi, the Secretariat was told to enfeoff one senior Song clansman as prince.
units.literal: Day jiazi, edict to the Secretariat-Chancellery: examine one senior kinsman of recent imperial descent and enfeoff him as king.

units.zh: 丙寅，罷宗諤平章事。
units.en: On bingyin, Zongnu left the council.
units.literal: Day bingyin: Zongnu was dismissed as co-director.

units.zh: 丁卯，遣張宗益等賀遼主生辰、正旦。
units.en: On dingmao, envoys left for Liao's birthday and New Year.
units.literal: Day dingmao: Zhang Zongyi and others were sent to congratulate the Liao ruler's birthday and new year.

units.zh: 九月辛未，太祖曾孫舒國公從式進封安定郡王。
units.en: Ninth month, xinwei: Congshi became Prince of Anding.
units.literal: Ninth month, day xinwei: Taizu's great-great-grandson Prince of Shu Congshi was advanced to Prince of Anding.

units.zh: 丁亥，減後妃臣僚薦奏推恩。
units.en: On dinghai, empresses' and officials' favor nominations were trimmed.
units.literal: Day dinghai: favor extensions through consort and official nominations were reduced.

units.zh: 戊子，莫州地震，有聲如雷。
units.en: On wuzi, Mo prefecture shook with a sound like thunder.
units.literal: Day wuzi: Mo prefecture earthquake; sound like thunder.

units.zh: 丁酉，詔三司裁定宗室月料，嫁娶、生日、郊禮給賜。
units.en: On dingyou, clan stipends and ritual gifts were put on a fixed budget.
units.literal: Day dingyou, edict: the Three Departments were to fix monthly stipends for the imperial clan, and gifts for marriage, birthdays, and suburban rites.

units.zh: 冬十月辛丑，給天下系囚衣食薪炭。
units.en: Tenth month, xinchou: every jail received winter clothes and fuel.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinchou: clothing, food, and fuel were given prisoners empire-wide.

units.zh: 乙卯，出奉宸庫珠，付河北買馬。
units.en: On yimao, palace pearls went to Hebei for horses.
units.literal: Day yimao: pearls from the inner treasure were released to Hebei to buy horses.

units.zh: 戊辰，禁銷金服飾。
units.en: On wuchen, gold-thread robes were banned.
units.literal: Day wuchen: melting gold for clothing ornament was forbidden.

units.zh: 十一月癸酉，太白晝見。
units.en: Eleventh month, guiyou: Venus shone at noon.
units.literal: Eleventh month, day guiyou: Venus appeared by day.

units.zh: 癸未，命宰臣禱雪。
units.en: On guiwei, the cabinet prayed for snow.
units.literal: Day guiwei: chief ministers were ordered to pray for snow.

units.zh: 丙戌，朝饗太廟，遂齋于郊宮。
units.en: On bingxu, the court feasted the ancestors and fasted at the suburban lodge.
units.literal: Day bingxu: the ancestral temple was feasted; then fasting at the suburban palace.

units.zh: 廢青城後苑。
units.en: Green City's rear park was closed.
units.literal: The rear garden of Green City was abolished.

units.zh: 丁亥，祀天地於圜丘，大赦，群臣進秩有差。
units.en: On dinghai, the round-altar rites brought amnesty and widespread promotion.
units.literal: Day dinghai: Heaven and Earth were sacrificed at the round altar; great amnesty; officials advanced in rank by degree.

units.zh: 乙未，京師及莫州地震。
units.en: On yiwei, capital and Mo shook again.
units.literal: Day yiwei: the capital and Mo prefecture earthquake.

units.zh: 十二月己亥朔，命宰臣禱雪。
units.en: Twelfth month, jihai new moon: the cabinet prayed for snow.
units.literal: Twelfth month, day jihai, first of month: chief ministers were ordered to pray for snow.

units.zh: 癸卯，瀛州地大震。
units.en: On guimao, Yingzhou suffered a violent quake.
units.literal: Day guimao: Ying prefecture great earthquake.

units.zh: 庚戌，賜夏國主秉常詔，許納塞門、安遠二砦歸其綏州。
units.en: On gengxu, Bingchang was offered Suizhou if he returned Saimen and Anyuan.
units.literal: Day gengxu: an edict was bestowed on Xia ruler Bingchang permitting return of Saimen and Anyuan forts in exchange for Suizhou.

units.zh: 辛亥，錄唐段秀實後。
units.en: On xinhai, Duan Xiushi's heirs were ennobled.
units.literal: Day xinhai: descendants of Tang's Duan Xiushi were recorded and honored.

units.zh: 癸丑，禱雪於郊廟、社稷。
units.en: On guichou, snow prayers filled the suburban shrines.
units.literal: Day guichou: snow was prayed for at suburban temples and the altars of soil and grain.

units.zh: 庚申，以判汝州富弼爲集禧觀使，詔乘驛赴闕。
units.en: On gengshen, Fu Bi was recalled from Ruzhou at gallop.
units.literal: Day gengshen: Fu Bi, administrator of Ruzhou, was made commissioner of Jixi Abbey and ordered post-haste to court.

units.zh: 壬戌，雪。
units.en: On renxu, snow fell at last.
units.literal: Day renxu: snow.

units.zh: 甲子，遼遣耶律公質等來賀正旦。
units.en: On jiazi, Liao envoys came for New Year.
units.literal: Day jiazi: Liao sent Yelü Gongzhi and others to congratulate the new year.

units.zh: 二年春正月甲午，奉安英宗神御于景靈宮英德殿。
units.en: Year two, first month, jiawu: Yingzong's spirit entered Jingling's Yingde Hall.
units.literal: Year two, spring, first month, day jiawu: Yingzong's spirit tablet was installed at Yingde Hall, Jingling Palace.

units.zh: 二月己亥，以富弼同中書門下平章事。
units.en: Second month, jihai: Fu Bi joined the council.
units.literal: Second month, day jihai: Fu Bi was made co-director of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

units.zh: 庚子，以王安石參知政事。
units.en: On gengzi, Wang Anshi entered the council.
units.literal: Day gengzi: Wang Anshi became participating administrator.

units.zh: 命翰林學士呂公著修《英宗實錄》。
units.en: Lü Gongzhu was assigned Yingzong's Veritable Records.
units.literal: Hanlin academician Lü Gongzhu was ordered to compile Veritable Records of Yingzong.

units.zh: 乙巳，帝以災變避正殿，減膳徹樂。
units.en: On yisi, portents brought austerity—no hall, lean table, no music.
units.literal: Day yisi: because of omens, the emperor avoided the main hall, reduced meals, and withdrew music.

units.zh: 甲子，陳升之、王安石創置三司條例，議行新法。
units.en: On jiazi, Chen and Wang founded the New Policies bureau.
units.literal: Day jiazi: Chen Shengzhi and Wang Anshi created the Three Departments Regulations Office to debate new laws.

units.zh: 三月乙酉，詔漕運、鹽鐵等官各具財用利害以聞。
units.en: Third month, yiyou: revenue officers filed cost-and-benefit reports.
units.literal: Third month, day yiyou, edict: transport, salt, and iron officials each memorialized fiscal gains and losses.

units.zh: 丙戌，命宰臣禱雨。
units.en: On bingxu, the cabinet prayed for rain.
units.literal: Day bingxu: chief ministers were ordered to pray for rain.

units.zh: 戊子，秉常上誓表，納塞門、安遠二砦，乞綏州，詔許之。
units.en: On wuzi, Bingchang swore to return two forts for Suizhou; the throne agreed.
units.literal: Day wuzi: Bingchang submitted a sworn memorial, returning Saimen and Anyuan forts and begging Suizhou; edict granted.

units.zh: 乙未，以旱慮囚。
units.en: On yiwei, drought brought a prison review.
units.literal: Day yiwei: because of drought, prisoners were reviewed.

units.zh: 四月丁酉朔，群臣再上尊號，不許。
units.en: Fourth month, dingyou new moon: another honorific title was refused.
units.literal: Fourth month, day dingyou, new moon: ministers again offered a grand honorific; refused.

units.zh: 戊戌，省內外土木工。
units.en: On wuxu, palace and public works were halted.
units.literal: Day wuxu: civil and military construction within and without was suspended.

units.zh: 壬寅，遼遣耶律昌等來賀同天節。
units.en: On renyin, Liao envoys came for Shared Heaven.
units.literal: Day renyin: Liao sent Yelü Chang and others to congratulate Shared Heaven festival.

units.zh: 丁未，唐介薨，臨其喪。
units.en: On dingwei, Tang Jie died; the emperor mourned at his bier.
units.literal: Day dingwei: Tang Jie died; the emperor attended the mourning.

units.zh: 戊申，宰臣富弼、曾公亮以旱上表待罪，詔不允。
units.en: On wushen, Fu Bi and Zeng Gongliang offered resignations over drought; refused.
units.literal: Day wushen: chief ministers Fu Bi and Zeng Gongliang submitted guilt memorials over drought; edict refused.

units.zh: 癸丑，命曾公亮爲西京奏安仁宗、英宗御容禮儀使。
units.en: On guichou, Zeng Gongliang oversaw Western Capital portrait rites.
units.literal: Day guichou: Zeng Gongliang was made ritual commissioner for installing Renzong and Yingzong portraits at the Western Capital.

units.zh: 丁巳，遣使諸路，察農田水利賦役。
units.en: On dingsi, inspectors fanned out to audit fields, canals, and levies.
units.literal: Day dingsi: envoys were sent on each circuit to inspect farmland, waterworks, and tax corvée.

units.zh: 戊午，外任大使臣年七十以上，令監司體量，直除致仕者，更不與子孫推恩。
units.en: On wuwu, direct retirement at seventy ended heirs' favor nominations.
units.literal: Day wuwu: for outer officials seventy and above, if the circuit inspector judged them fit for direct retirement, their descendants would receive no further favor extensions.

units.zh: 甲子，御殿復膳。
units.en: On jiazi, the emperor returned to full rations.
units.literal: Day jiazi: the throne resumed full meals in the hall.

units.zh: 免河北歸業流民夏稅。
units.en: Hebei returnees were freed from summer tax.
units.literal: Summer tax was remitted for Hebei refugees returning to their fields.

units.zh: 五月辛未，宴紫宸殿，初用樂。
units.en: Fifth month, xinwei: Zichen Hall banquet—music returned.
units.literal: Fifth month, day xinwei: a banquet at Zichen Hall; music was used for the first time.

units.zh: 己卯，賜河北役兵特支錢。
units.en: On jimao, Hebei labor troops received bonus cash.
units.literal: Day jimao: special pay was given Hebei corvée troops.

units.zh: 癸未，翰林學士鄭獬罷知杭州，宣徽北院使王拱辰罷判應天府，知制誥錢公輔罷知江寧府。
units.en: On guiwei, Hanlin Academician Zheng Xie was removed to administer Hangzhou, Northern Court Xuanhui Commissioner Wang Gongchen was removed to judge Yingtian Prefecture, and Drafter of Edicts Qian Gongfu was removed to administer Jiangning Prefecture.
units.literal: Day guiwei: Hanlin academician Zheng Xie was dismissed as Hang prefect; North Courtyard commissioner Wang Gongchen as Ying prefect; drafting academician Qian Gongfu as Jiangning prefect.

units.zh: 丁亥，奉安仁宗、英宗御容于會聖宮及應天院。
units.en: On dinghai, Renzong and Yingzong entered their portrait halls.
units.literal: Day dinghai: portraits of Renzong and Yingzong were installed at Huisheng Palace and Yingtian Abbey.

units.zh: 甲午，減西京囚罪一等。
units.en: On jiawu, Luoyang sentences were cut one grade.
units.literal: Day jiawu: Western Capital prisoners' crimes were reduced one degree.

units.zh: 台州民延贊等九人，年各百歲以上，並授本州助教。
units.en: Nine Taizhou elders past one hundred became honorary prefectural instructors.
units.literal: Taizhou commoners Yan Zan and eight others, each over one hundred years, were all made assistant instructors of the prefecture.

units.zh: 六月丁巳，右諫議大夫、御史中丞呂誨以論王安石，罷知鄧州。
units.en: Sixth month, dingsi: Lü Hui, who had attacked Wang Anshi, was sent to Dengzhou.
units.literal: Sixth month, day dingsi: right remonstrance officer and censor-in-chief Lü Hui was dismissed as Deng prefect for criticizing Wang Anshi.

units.zh: 以翰林學士呂公著爲御史中丞。
units.en: Lü Gongzhu became censor-in-chief.
units.literal: Hanlin academician Lü Gongzhu was made censor-in-chief.

units.zh: 命龍圖閣直學士張掞兼編排錄用勳臣子孫。
units.en: Zhang Shan was told to register meritorious ministers' heirs for office.
units.literal: Dragon Diagram direct academician Zhang Shan was also ordered to compile and employ descendants of meritorious ministers.

units.zh: 壬戌，太白晝見。
units.en: On renxu, Venus shone at noon.
units.literal: Day renxu: Venus appeared by day.

units.zh: 秋七月乙丑朔，日當食，雲陰不見。
units.en: Seventh month, yichou new moon: clouds veiled the expected eclipse.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day yichou, new moon: an eclipse was due; clouds hid it.

units.zh: 庚午，詔御史中丞舉推直官及可兼權御史者。
units.en: On gengwu, the censor-in-chief was to name bold investigators.
units.literal: Day gengwu, edict: the censor-in-chief was to nominate push investigators and men fit to act as censors.

units.zh: 甲戌，東平郡王允弼薨。
units.en: On xinsi, Prince Yunbi died.
units.literal: Day xinsi: Prince of Dongping Yunbi died.

units.zh: 辛巳，立淮、浙、江、湖六路均輸法。
units.en: On xinhai, the equal-transport system began on six southeastern circuits.
units.literal: Day xinhai: the equal-transport law was established on the Huai, Zhe, Jiang, and lake circuits.

units.zh: 壬午，振恤被水州軍，仍蠲竹木稅及酒課。
units.en: On renwu, flood counties were fed and their timber and wine taxes forgiven.
units.literal: Day renwu: flood-struck prefectures and armies were relieved; bamboo-wood tax and wine levy were remitted.

units.zh: 癸未，詔自今文臣換右職者，須實有謀勇，曾著績效，即得取旨。
units.en: On guiwei, civil-to-military transfers required proven battlefield merit.
units.literal: Day guiwei, edict: from now on when civil officials exchanged to military rank, they must truly have counsel and courage and recorded achievement before imperial approval.

units.zh: 甲申，日下有五色雲。
units.en: On jiashen, five-colored clouds ringed the sun.
units.literal: Day jiashen: five-colored clouds appeared beneath the sun.

units.zh: 己丑，韓琦上《仁宗實錄》，曾公亮上《英宗實錄》。
units.en: On jichou, Renzong's and Yingzong's Veritable Records were submitted.
units.literal: Day jichou: Han Qi presented Veritable Records of Renzong; Zeng Gongliang presented Veritable Records of Yingzong.

units.zh: 八月癸卯，侍御史劉琦貶監處州鹽酒務，御史裏行錢顗貶監衢州鹽稅，亦以論安石故。
units.en: Eighth month, guimao: Liu Qi and Qian Yi, who had opposed Anshi, were banished to salt posts.
units.literal: Eighth month, day guimao: attendant censor Liu Qi was demoted to salt-and-wine commissioner of Chuzhou; censor trainee Qian Yi to salt tax of Quzhou—both for criticizing Anshi.

units.zh: 乙巳，殿中侍御史孫昌齡以論新法，貶通判蘄州。
units.en: On yisi, Sun Changling was exiled for attacking the New Policies.
units.literal: Day yisi: palace attendant Sun Changling was demoted to Tong prefect for criticizing the new laws.

units.zh: 丙午，同修起居注範純仁以言事多忤安石，罷同知諫院。
units.en: On bingwu, Fan Chunren, co-compiler of the court diary, was dismissed as co-administrator of the Remonstrance Bureau because his criticisms had repeatedly offended Wang Anshi.
units.literal: Day bingwu: co-author of the diary Fan Chunren was dismissed as co-director of the Remonstrance Bureau for repeatedly opposing Anshi.

units.zh: 戊申，河徙東行。
units.en: On wushen, the Yellow River turned east.
units.literal: Day wushen: the Yellow River shifted eastward.

units.zh: 夏國請從舊蕃儀，詔許之。
units.en: Xia was permitted its former tribal rites.
units.literal: Western Xia asked to follow the old Fan ritual; edict granted.

units.zh: 己酉，範純仁知河中府。
units.en: On jiyou, Fan Chunren went to Hezhong.
units.literal: Day jiyou: Fan Chunren was made Hezhong prefect.

units.zh: 甲寅，朝神御殿。
units.en: On jiayin, the court met at the Spirit Hall.
units.literal: Day jiayin: audience at the Spirit Hall.

units.zh: 辛酉，以秘書省著作佐郎程顥、王子韶並爲太子中允、權監察御史裏行。
units.en: On xinyou, Cheng Hao and Wang Zishao became acting censors.
units.literal: Day xinyou: Secretariat registrars Cheng Hao and Wang Zishao were both made crown prince attendants and acting investigating censors.

units.zh: 壬戌，待御史知雜事劉述、同判刑部丁諷坐受刑名敕不即下，述貶知江州，諷貶通判復州。
units.en: On renxu, Liu Shu, investigating censor managing miscellaneous affairs, and Ding Feng, co-administrator of the Ministry of Punishments, were punished for receiving a penal edict and failing to issue it promptly: Shu was demoted to administer Jiang Prefecture, and Feng to be assistant prefect of Fu Prefecture.
units.literal: Day renxu: chief investigating censor Liu Shu and Punishments co-administrator Ding Feng were punished for delaying a penal edict: Shu demoted to Jiang prefect; Feng to Tong prefect of Fu.

units.zh: 審刑院詳議官王師元坐言許遵所議刑名不當，貶監安州稅。
units.en: Wang Shiyuan was exiled for rejecting Xu Zun's harsh code.
units.literal: Detailed deliberation officer Wang Shiyuan of the Review Office was punished for saying Xu Zun's penal opinion was wrong; demoted to An tax commissioner.

units.zh: 九月甲子朔，交州來貢。
units.en: Ninth month, jiazi new moon: Jiaozhi sent tribute.
units.literal: Ninth month, day jiazi, new moon: Jiaozhi came to offer tribute.

units.zh: 乙丑，以古勿峒效順首領儂智會爲右千牛衛大將軍。
units.en: On yichou, Nong Zhihui of Gumu Cave received a general's rank.
units.literal: Day yichou: Gumu Cave submitter chief Nong Zhihui was made great general of the right thousand-oxen guard.

units.zh: 丁卯，立常平給斂法。
units.en: On dingmao, the ever-normal granary system was proclaimed.
units.literal: Day dingmao: the ever-normal granary loan-and-storage law was established.

units.zh: 戊辰，出內庫緡錢百萬糴河北常平粟。
units.en: On wuchen, a million strings bought Hebei reserve grain.
units.literal: Day wuchen: one million strings from the inner treasury bought ever-normal grain in Hebei.

units.zh: 丁丑，遣孫固等賀遼主生辰、正旦。
units.en: On dingchou, Sun Gu's mission left for Liao.
units.literal: Day dingchou: Sun Gu and others were sent to congratulate the Liao ruler's birthday and new year.

units.zh: 辛卯，廢奉慈廟。
units.en: On xinmao, Fengci temple was closed.
units.literal: Day xinmao: Fengci temple was abolished.

units.zh: 壬辰，以秘書省著作佐郎呂惠卿爲太子中允、崇政殿說書。
units.en: On renchen, Lü Huiqing entered the heir's school and lecture hall.
units.literal: Day renchen: Secretariat registrar Lü Huiqing was made crown prince attendant and lecturer at Chongzheng Hall.

units.zh: 冬十月丙申，富弼罷爲武甯軍節度使、判亳州。
units.en: Tenth month, bingshen: Fu Bi left the council for Bozhou.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingshen: Fu Bi was dismissed and made Wuning military commissioner and administrator of Bozhou.

units.zh: 曾公亮、陳升之並同中書門下平章事。
units.en: Zeng Gongliang and Chen Shengzhi became co-chancellors.
units.literal: Zeng Gongliang and Chen Shengzhi both became co-directors of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

units.zh: 城綏州，命郭逵選將置守具。
units.en: Suizhou was fortified; Guo Kui chose garrison commanders.
units.literal: Suizhou was walled; Guo Kui was ordered to choose generals and prepare defenses.

units.zh: 逵遣趙禼交夏人所納安遠、塞門二砦，就定地界。
units.en: Guo Kui sent Zhao Xi to take Xia's two forts and fix the line.
units.literal: Kui sent Zhao Xi to receive the two forts Anyuan and Saimen that the Xia had surrendered and fix the border.

units.zh: 夏人渝初盟，禼請城綏州，不以易二砦，因改名綏德城。
units.en: When Xia broke faith, Zhao Xi walled Suizhou without yielding the forts—the place was renamed Suide.
units.literal: The Xia broke the first treaty; Xi asked to wall Suizhou without trading the two forts; it was therefore renamed Suide city.

units.zh: 戊戌，以蕃官禮賓使折繼世爲忠州刺史，左監門衛將軍嵬名山爲供備庫使，仍賜姓名趙懷順。
units.en: On wuxu, Fan official Zhe Jishi was made prefect of Zhongzhou, and Wei Mingshan was made supply commissioner and given the name Zhao Huaishun.
units.literal: Day wuxu: Fan official ritual guest commissioner Zhe Jishi was made Zhong prefect; left gate guard general Wei Mingshan was made supply commissioner and given the surname Zhao and name Huaishun.

units.zh: 丙辰，詔御史請對，並許直由閣門上殿。
units.en: On bingchen, censors won the right to petition straight through the gate.
units.literal: Day bingchen, edict: censors requesting audience were permitted direct access through the Gate Office.

units.zh: 戊午，宗諤復平章事。
units.en: On wuwu, Zong'e returned to the council.
units.literal: Day wuwu: Zong'e again became co-director.

units.zh: 己未，夏人來謝封冊。
units.en: On jiwei, Xia envoys thanked the throne for the seal.
units.literal: Day jiwei: the Xia came to thank the investiture.

units.zh: 辛酉，錄楊承信曾孫立、田重進曾孫章爲三班借職。
units.en: On xinyou, heirs of Yang Chengxin and Tian Zhongjin entered service.
units.literal: Day xinyou: Yang Chengxin's great-grandson Li and Tian Zhongjin's great-grandson Zhang were recorded as third-rank agents.

units.zh: 十一月乙丑，命韓絳制置三司條例。
units.en: Eleventh month, yichou: Han Jiang took the New Policies office.
units.literal: Eleventh month, day yichou: Han Jiang was made director of the Three Departments Regulations Office.

units.zh: 甲戌，詔祖宗之後世襲補外官，非袒免親罷賜名授官。
units.en: On jiaxu, distant imperial clansmen lost automatic favor appointments.
units.literal: Day jiaxu, edict: descendants of the founders who inherited outer offices were not to receive bestowed names and appointment unless within the five mourning degrees.

units.zh: 丙子，罷諸路提刑武臣。
units.en: On bingzi, military judicial inspectors were removed.
units.literal: Day bingzi: military circuit penal inspectors were abolished.

units.zh: 頒《農田水利約束》。
units.en: The Farmland and Waterworks code was issued.
units.literal: Regulations on farmland and waterworks were promulgated.

units.zh: 壬午，御邇英閣聽講。
units.en: On renwu, he heard lecture in Erying Hall.
units.literal: Day renwu: he heard lecture in Erying Hall.

units.zh: 賜汴口役兵錢。
units.en: Bian River labor troops received bonus pay.
units.literal: Cash was given corvée troops at the Bian ford.

units.zh: 己丑，減天下囚罪一等，徒以下釋之。
units.en: On jichou, a general amnesty cut sentences and freed the lightly punished.
units.literal: Day jichou: crimes were reduced one degree empire-wide; those below exile were released.

units.zh: 閏月庚子，浚御河。
units.en: Intercalary month, gengzi: the imperial canal was cleared.
units.literal: Intercalary month, day gengzi: the imperial canal was dredged.

units.zh: 壬子，置交子務。
units.en: On renzi, the government note bureau opened.
units.literal: Day renzi: the paper-money office was established.

units.zh: 是月，差官提舉諸路常平廣惠倉，兼管勾農田水利差役事。
units.en: That month, granary commissioners on every circuit also took charge of fields, water, and corvée.
units.literal: That month: officials were dispatched to superintend ever-normal and broad-relief granaries on each circuit and also manage farmland, waterworks, and corvée affairs.

units.zh: 十二月癸亥朔，復減後妃公主及臣僚推恩。
units.en: Twelfth month, guihai new moon: empresses' and officials' favor grants were cut again.
units.literal: Twelfth month, day guihai, new moon: favor extensions for consorts, princesses, and officials were again reduced.

units.zh: 癸酉，增失入死罪法。
units.en: On guiyou, penalties for wrongful death sentences were stiffened.
units.literal: Day guiyou: the law on erroneous capital conviction was increased.

units.zh: 丙戌，增三京留司御史台、國子監及宮觀官，以處卿監、監司、知州之老者。
units.en: On bingxu, sinecures multiplied for retired senior officials.
units.literal: Day bingxu: posts at the three capital remonstrance bureaus, the Imperial University, and abbey offices were increased to place aged ministers, inspectors, and prefects.

units.zh: 戊子，遼遣蕭惟禧來賀正旦。
units.en: On wuzi, Liao envoys came for New Year.
units.literal: Day wuzi: Liao sent Xiao Weixi and others to congratulate the new year.

units.zh: 是歲，交州來貢。
units.en: That year, Jiaozhi again sent tribute.
